description: This file defines bindings for window management in a Lua-C integration, including functions for creating windows, controlling draw loops, setting frame rate, saving screenshots, and global window properties.

methods.name: createWindow
methods.description: Creates a GLFW window with specified width, height, and optional rendering mode.

methods.name: noLoop
methods.description: Stops the continuous calling of the draw function.

methods.name: frameRate
methods.description: Sets or gets the frame rate of the window.

methods.name: saveWindow
methods.description: Saves the current window as an image file.
